42630-the-outdoor-chums-in-the-big-woods.creator: Unknown
42630-the-outdoor-chums-in-the-big-woods.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The last speaker was Frank Langdon. His three comrades had always been proud to look up to Frank as their leader. They had been through a great many lively adventures together, and up to the present no one had ever found cause to regret the fact that when it came to deciding on their plans Frank’s word carried the greatest weight.

arxiv-2011-14597.title: A Survey on Deep Learning for Software Engineering Journal: CSUR Volume: 1 1 1 1 DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456
arxiv-2011-14597.creator: Yanming Yang, Xin Xia, David Lo, John Grundy
arxiv-2011-14597.description: Abstract . In 2006, Geoffrey Hinton proposed the concept of training “Deep Neural Networks (DNNs)” and an improved model training method to break the bottleneck of neural network development. More recently, the introduction of AlphaGo in 2016 demonstrated the powerful learning ability of deep learning and its enormous potential.

arxiv-2207-13036.title: Jacobian Norm with Selective Input Gradient Regularization for Improved and Interpretable Adversarial Defense
arxiv-2207-13036.creator: Deyin Liu, Lin Wu, Haifeng Zhao, Farid Boussaid, Mohammed Bennamoun, Xianghua Xie
arxiv-2207-13036.description: Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) are known to be vulnerable to adversarial examples that are crafted with imperceptible perturbations, i.e., a small change in an input image can induce a mis-classification, and thus threatens the reliability of deep learning based deployment systems. Adversarial training (AT) is often adopted to improve robustness through training a mixture of corrupted and clean data.

arxiv-2405-06045.title: Hybrid Stabilizer Matrix Product Operator
arxiv-2405-06045.creator: Antonio Francesco Mello, Alessandro Santini, Mario Collura
arxiv-2405-06045.description: Abstract We introduce a novel hybrid approach combining tensor network methods with the stabilizer formalism to address the challenges of simulating many-body quantum systems. By integrating these techniques, we enhance our ability to accurately model unitary dynamics while mitigating the exponential growth of entanglement encountered in classical simulations.

arxiv-2602-04972.title: Learning Context Matters: Measuring and Diagnosing Personalization Gaps in LLM-Based Instructional Design
arxiv-2602-04972.creator: Johaun Hatchett, Debshila Basu Mallick, Brittany C. Bradford, Richard G. Baraniuk
arxiv-2602-04972.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Johaun Hatchett, Debshila Basu Mallick, Brittany C. Bradford, Richard G. Baraniuk. The adoption of generative AI in education has accelerated dramatically in recent years, with Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly integrated into learning environments in the hope of providing personalized support that enhances learner engagement and knowledge retention. However, truly personalized support requires access to meaningful Learning Context (LC) regarding who the learner is, what they are trying to understand, and how they are engaging with the material.

The virus was initially detected in a nasopharyngeal aspirate from a 3-year-old child from Australia diagnosed with...

pmc-10498627.title: Updated recommendations on the therapeutic role of extracorporeal shock wave therapy for peyronie’s disease: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10498627.creator: Xiaofeng Wang, Hongquan Liu, Gonglin Tang, Gang Wu, Yongli Chu, Jitao Wu, Yuanshan Cui
pmc-10498627.description: BackgroundThe therapeutic role of extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT) for Peyronie’s disease (PD) has been controversial in a long term. We aimed to further evaluate the therapeutic effect of ESWT for PD on the basis of available high-quality studies.MethodsThe PubMed, CENTRAL and Embase databases were searched for articles published from January 1st, 2000 to December 31, 2022.

pmc-10552868.title: The feasibility and efficiency for constructing arteriovenous fistula with <2 mm vein—a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10552868.creator: Ruijia Feng, Siwen Wang, Jianwen Yu, Xunhua Zheng, Wei Chen, Xin Wang, Guangqi Chang
pmc-10552868.description: BackgroundAutogenous arteriovenous fistula (AVF) is an efficient hemodialysis access for patients with end-stage kidney disease (ESKD). The specific threshold of vein diameter still not reached a consensus.MethodWe conducted a comprehensive search in PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases for articles which comparing the treatment outcomes of AVF with 2 mm as vein diameter threshold.

pmc-10567529.title: Case Report of a Post-Traumatic Hydrocephalus Patient: Ventriculo-Vesicle Shunt With a Review of the Literature
pmc-10567529.creator: Gyubin Lee, Kum Whang, Sungmin Cho, Jongyeon Kim, Byeongoh Kim, Yeongyu Jang, Jongwook Choi
pmc-10567529.description: Post-traumatic hydrocephalus (PTH) is treated through cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) diversion, typically through ventriculoperitoneal shunt (VPS) or other bypass techniques. As these shunts are associated with significant complications and high revision rates in certain populations, it is important to tailor a patient’s shunt procedure according to their medical history and complications.

pmc-11492480.title: A review of the response and the emergency medical team (EMT) deployment following a tanker explosion in Freetown, Sierra Leone
pmc-11492480.creator: Boniface Oyugi, Ibrahim Franklyn Kamara, Innocent Nuwagira, Robert Musoke, Sulaiman Lakoh, Abdulai Jalloh, Rashidatu Fouad Kamara, Pryanka Relan, Camila Lajolo, René André Macodou Ndiaye, Babacar Niang, Mouhamadou Mansour Fall, Thierno Balde, Flavio Salio, Mustapha Kabba
pmc-11492480.description: BackgroundOn 5 November 2021, a fire incident following a tanker explosion occurred in the Wellington PMB Junction east of Freetown, Sierra Leone, injuring and killing people. WHO facilitated the deployment of international emergency medical teams (EMTs) to support the Ministry of Health (MoH) in providing care to the wounded in four hospitals.

pmc-11628465.title: Age-stratification reveals age-specific intestinal microbiota signatures in juvenile idiopathic arthritis
pmc-11628465.creator: Lisa Budzinski, Toni Sempert, Leonie Lietz, René Maier, Gi-Ung Kang, Anne Sae Lim von Stuckrad, Carl Christoph Goetzke, Maria Roth, Aayushi Shah, Amro Abbas, Katrin Lehman, Kathleen Necke, Stefanie Bartsch, Ute Hoffmann, Mir-Farzin Mashreghi, Robert Biesen, Tilmann Kallinich, Hyun-Dong Chang
pmc-11628465.description: ObjectiveJuvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JIA) comprises diverse chronic inflammatory conditions driven by malfunction of the immune system. The intestinal microbiota is considered a crucial environmental factor correlating with chronic inflammatory diseases, and for JIA certain alterations in the microbiota have already been described.

pmc-12611075.title: Bioprotective and Technological Roles of Lactic Acid Bacteria in Reduced-Sodium Fermented Sausages
pmc-12611075.creator: Marcello Lima Bertuci, Camila Vespúcio Bis Souza, Carlos Alberto Alves, Svetoslav Dimitrov Todorov, Ana Lúcia Barretto Penna, Andrea Carla da Silva Barretto, Ioanna Mantzourani
pmc-12611075.description: Fermented sausages are popular worldwide due to their sensory and nutritional characteristics, as well as their convenience for storage and consumption. The production and consumption of meat products are associated with negative impacts from the risks of high sodium intake, such as cardiovascular disease and hypertension.

pmc-12632421.title: Ultra‐Conserved Poison Exons Enable Rapid and Safe Splicing Factor Gene Expression Switches: A Hypothesis
pmc-12632421.creator: Caroline Dalgliesh, Farimah Ghorbani, Adam J M Wollman, David J Elliott
pmc-12632421.description: Most vertebrate genes are split up into exons and introns, with exons being spliced together to make mRNA. Many of the proteins involved in splicing, called splicing factors, exert concentration‐dependent effects on gene expression through post‐transcriptional modification of mRNAs. These include the serine/arginine‐enriched (SR) proteins that have essential roles in normal development and physiology.

pmc-12983815.title: Beyond support: a qualitative exploration of the emotional and relational impact of male partner involvement in maternal healthcare in Ghana
pmc-12983815.creator: Christiana Asiedu, Emmanuella Florence Odi Asiedu, Eunice Johnson, Prince Narkotey, Enoch Nana Yaw Koomson
pmc-12983815.description: IntroductionMale partner involvement in maternal healthcare is crucial for improving maternal and child health, especially in low- and middle-income countries. Traditionally viewed as a woman’s domain, pregnancy often excludes men, yet their engagement enhances antenatal care, nutrition, medical adherence and outcomes.

pmc-13056125.title: Biomechanical anticoagulation by spherical platelets in extracorporeal systems
pmc-13056125.creator: Rui Ji, Yongjian Li, Jiang Li, Haosheng Chen
pmc-13056125.description: SignificanceExtracorporeal life support currently relies on systemic anticoagulant drugs to keep circuits patent, but these drugs inevitably increase bleeding risk. The need to prevent thrombosis without increasing bleeding risk remains a major challenge. This work exploits platelet spherification, a reversible change from discoid to spherical shape, to prevent thrombosis while preserving hemostatic potential.

pmc-13294820.title: Neurodevelopmental and behavioral correlates of household structure independent of socioeconomic status
pmc-13294820.creator: Kaitlynn E Ellis, Amar Camara, Camille Archer, Yulan D Chen, Antonia N Kaczkurkin
pmc-13294820.description: IntroductionParental socioeconomic status (SES) is associated with children’s brain development and mental health but does not fully capture variation in caregiving environments. Household structure, including the number of caregivers in the home, may also shape children’s experiences through differences in supervision, support, and daily demands.

pmc-13692970.title: Developing a cps-genotyping scheme for the emerging zoonotic pathogen Streptococcus parasuis through genetic analysis of capsular polysaccharide synthesis gene loci
pmc-13692970.creator: Xiyan Zhang, Xueli Yi, Jianping Wang, Juan Li, Nahuel Fittipaldi, Wenbo Luo, Yan Wang, Chaoyuan Yuan, Wenfei Wei, Xuezhen Li, Jinhui Zhang, Marcelo Gottschalk, Han Zheng, Jianguo Xu
pmc-13692970.description: BackgroundStreptococcus parasuis is an emerging zoonotic pathogen responsible for pneumonia, meningitis, peritonitis, pleuritis, nephritis, cellulitis, cholecystitis, sepsis, and arthritis in humans. The continuous increase in reported human cases of S. parasuis infection indicates its growing threat to public health and highlights the urgent need to monitor its epidemiology.
